messages:
Jordan (Head of Infra): Quick follow-up from today's infra all‑hands — wanted to capture the clarifications we promised on capacity, regions, and autoscale behavior. Posting answers + next steps here.
Priya (EngOps): thanks! can you confirm APAC GPU availability window? a few teams asked about region parity.
Jordan (Head of Infra): Short answer: targeted GA for APAC node pools is mid‑Q2, but initial capacity (pilot) opens earlier for dedicated customers. We still have procurement + rack scheduling to finalize.
Asha (SRE): When you say "pilot" — will that be self‑serve or invite only? and will autoscale policies behave the same as NA?
Michael (Infra Lead): Pilot = invite-only (we'll onboard 2–3 teams). Autoscale: same controller logic identical across regions, but node types differ (NVIDIA A100 in NA vs A10‑like SKUs in APAC). That means scheduler will prefer lower-latency node pools for latency‑sensitive routes, but throughput SLOs are preserved via burst pools.
Priya (EngOps): do we have a clear downgrade/fallback plan for dedicated customers if APAC preemptible capacity drops?
Michael (Infra Lead): yes — two mechanisms: 1) automatic traffic spillover to NA/EMEA (configurable per-customer), 2) local CPU fallback for low‑priority background jobs. For strict SLO customers we offer reserved burst capacity (paid addon).
Asha (SRE): any change to preemption risk profile with the new autoscaler? worried about cache warmup and KV eviction during scale‑in.
Michael (Infra Lead): good point — we're adding a scale‑in pause window to allow KV cache to be checkpointed for active contexts; scale decisions will prefer draining idle workers first. Still, short‑lived spikes may cause cache miss amplification — dev teams should expect a small warmup penalty.
ops-bot: Document uploaded: https://redwood.internal/infra/annex/APAC_capacity_plan_v1 (link)
Priya (EngOps): thanks — can we get a tl;dr in the docs for product teams? we should state the expected latency delta for APAC vs NA so PMs can plan.
Jordan (Head of Infra): Action: Michael will add a short summary with expected median P95 latency delta and suggested routing policy by Friday. Also we'll publish the initial onboarding checklist for pilot customers.
Michael (Infra Lead): noted. I'll add the latency table + routing examples and create INFRA‑342 to track pilot invites + onboarding docs.
Asha (SRE): will the autoscale metrics be visible in the console for pilot customers? need visibility for cache hit rates and node churn.
Michael (Infra Lead): yes, pilot customers get extended telemetry in Console: node churn, cache hit ratio, and per‑route token latency. We'll include alert defaults for cache‑drop and CPU saturation.
Priya (EngOps): one more: any implications for Dedicated (reserved) customers re: cross‑region failover?
Jordan (Head of Infra): reserved customers can opt into automatic cross‑region failover; we will require a short DR playbook and pre‑warming steps. We'll surface recommended configs in the onboarding doc.
Asha (SRE): sounds good — will watch INFRA‑342. ping me if you want SRE to run a canary test.
Michael (Infra Lead): thank you. will schedule a canary with SRE and two pilot teams next week.
Jordan (Head of Infra): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick questions. If there are any sticky cases DM me and we'll escalate to the rollout working group. :thumbsup:
